t: Rising in front of you is Fulcrum, a huge sculpture by the American artist Richard Serra. It stands near the western entrance to Liverpool Street station, installed in 1987 as part of the Broadgate development. It's made of five pieces of Cor-Ten steel and is about seventeen metres tall. Serra was known for large abstract works made for particular sites, and for the relationship he explored between viewer, work and place. Deyan Sudjic, director of the Design Museum, has called Fulcrum one of London's design icons. Walk around it and see how it changes.
